user.title: Connect to Sycamore
user.description: Create an access token in Sycamore under My Organizer → Applications. Enter your Family ID to auto-discover students; leave it blank to add students by hand.

data_description.family_id: Found in your Sycamore family portal. When set, students are discovered automatically. Requires the token's Families scope; if discovery fails, leave this blank to add students manually.
data_description.school_id: Only needed for the cafeteria/lunch sensor.

select.title: Choose students
select.description: Select which students to add to Home Assistant.

manual.title: Add a student
manual.description: Enter a Sycamore Student ID and a display name.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Sycamore
reauth_confirm.description: Your Sycamore token was rejected. Enter a new access token.

error.invalid_auth: The access token was rejected. Check that it is valid and has the right scopes.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Sycamore. Try again shortly.
error.family_access_denied: Couldn't read the family list. Your access token may not have the 'Families' scope — leave Family ID blank to add students manually, or enable that scope in Sycamore.
error.no_students: No students were found for that Family ID.

abort.already_configured: This Sycamore account is already configured.

init.title: Sycamore options
init.description: Set polling and sensors below. To mirror a child's assignments/tests/quizzes into a calendar, pick a target calendar for that child (leave blank to not sync). Turn on auto-sync to keep it updated after every refresh.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll Sycamore. Minimum 60 minutes (Sycamore data changes at most daily).
data_description.attendance_enabled: When off, the attendance endpoint is not polled and its sensors are removed.
data_description.lunch_enabled: When off, the cafeteria endpoint is not polled and the lunch sensor is removed.
data_description.calendar_autosync: When on, each child with a target calendar is synced automatically after every poll. When off, use the sycamore.sync_calendar service manually.
data_description.calendar_days: How many days ahead of assignments/tests to put on the calendar.

sync_calendar.name: Sync calendar
sync_calendar.description: Mirror upcoming assignments, tests, and quizzes into a calendar (e.g. a Google calendar). Events it created are added, kept in sync, and removed when the item is cancelled; your own events are never touched.

target_calendar.name: Target calendar
target_calendar.description: Calendar to sync into. Optional — if omitted, each student's calendar from the integration options is used; if given, it overrides the mapping for all selected students.

student.name: Student(s)
student.description: Limit the sync to specific students (by name or id). Leave empty for all.

days.name: Days ahead
days.description: How many days ahead to sync.

prefix_student_name.name: Prefix student name
prefix_student_name.description: Put the student's name at the start of each event (useful for a shared calendar).
